kids: 🚀 Starlane MODERN: a brand-new 3D cockpit — look around with the right mouse button and see the whole cabin!
🖥️ Your ship’s screens are now built into the console, and the action buttons slide up when you need them
🖼️ In full screen, Modern now fills your whole widescreen
📋 A Mission Log tells you where you are and exactly what to do next
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader (Modern style): an enclosed 3D cockpit (canopy, glass glare, side walls and consoles, red-alert cabin lighting, head sway); the dashboard rebuilt as live screens in the 3D console; a modern font and glass buttons; a slide-up action bar; true widescreen in full screen; the aim ring and pointer hide while looking around. New Mission Log with a recap and next step for every mission, read aloud on request, and a welcome-back recap after a break. The arcade’s “Retro screen” scanlines are skipped in Modern style.

kids: 🌌 Starlane: 8 galaxies to explore — buy a galactic hyperdrive!
🏁 Station races, 🧳 passengers and ⛏️ mining contracts
🏆 The weekly Navigator’s Cup — and when you get a puzzle wrong, you see how to work it out
✨ Glowing docking guides, a hyperspace tunnel, shield flashes and a cockpit that boots up
🔊 Every ship sounds different, and the music changes with the system
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: smoother on slower machines (fixed-step timing, quality presets, FPS counter); worked explanations after wrong answers, adaptive weak-topic practice, repair and loading-bay puzzles, weekly Navigator’s Cup; docking corridor, target arrow, hyperspace tunnel, boot-up check, news ticker, ship detail, shield bubbles and explosion lighting; per-ship engine sounds and system music moods; 8 galaxies, economy events, and passenger, mining and race missions.

kids: 📖 Starlane: the help pages, Nova’s intro and the guided flight now explain exactly the controls you are using — mouse, keyboard or touch
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: How to play rewritten (new CONTROLS and EXTRAS pages), and all help — Nova’s intro, the guided flight, the Launch screen, console tips, hints and messages — now reads the live key settings and the control scheme (Modern, Classic or touch). Fixed: the Launch screen still said E for E.C.M. (it is U). Shift boost now also works with Classic controls; Tab cycles all three chart views. Main Help now explains the Starlane controls.

kids: 🚀 Starlane (MODERN): sit in a real 3D cockpit — hold the RIGHT mouse button and drag to look around!
🛬 The hangar is now fully 3D when you dock and launch
🔫 Fixed: lasers could get stuck firing
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: 3D cockpit model with look-around (right-drag on computers; Display → “3D cockpit model”), 3D hangar in the docking and launch movies, and a fix for firing getting stuck when the mouse button was released outside the game or the window lost focus.

kids: 🎯 Starlane: lock on with missiles, aim at enemy engines or weapons — and hire a wingman!
🤝 Earn the trust of the Federation, the Traders’ Guild… or the pirates
🔭 Survey planets, moons and stars, and sell your discoveries
🛰️ A new story: The Lost Freighter
🎓 Take the Academy Challenge at any station — 8 questions against the clock
🎵 Sound comes from where things are, and the music builds as danger grows
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: phone/tablet/computer profiles (phones start in Retro with lighter effects); 3D positional sound, fly-bys, muffled cockpit and three-layer music; missile lock-on, subsystem targeting, wingmen and flanking pirates; faction reputation; prices that react to trading; planet/moon/star surveys and a codex; story “The Lost Freighter”; route-risk probability question, Academy Challenge on Focus topics, and a Parent dashboard setting for how often maths appears; generated planet terrain in Modern.

kids: 🚀 Starlane Trader now starts in MODERN 3D — and the title screen shows off all three styles
🖱️ Fly with the mouse! W/S speed, A/D slide sideways, Q/E roll, Shift to BOOST
🌌 Nebula skies, lens flare, shiny oceans and city lights on the dark side of planets
📻 Station radio chatter — and pirates who taunt you!
📈 Read price graphs and plan routes for bonus credits
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: live attract screen cycling Original/Retro/Modern; Modern style and Modern (mouse) controls by default, with boost and sideways thrusters; nebula backdrops, lens flare, ocean shine, night-side city lights, 3D docking/launch exteriors; radio chatter; market price-trend and route-estimate maths; reduced motion and colour-safe radar; automatic switch to Retro if Modern is too slow.

kids: 🚀 Starlane Trader: in MODERN style the cockpit’s side windows and mirror now show real 3D
📡 A new holographic 3D radar (or keep the classic one) — zoom with [
🗺️ A 3D star map you can spin and zoom, with a route planner for long trips
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: Modern cockpit with 3D side windows and mirror, glass reflections, holographic edges and sun glints; Holo 3D radar (or Classic) with 5/10/25 km range; 3D star map with colour filters (economy, danger, tech, visited) and a shortest-route planner.

kids: 🚀 Starlane Trader has three styles: ORIGINAL (1984 green wireframe), RETRO and MODERN (real 3D with glowing lights and explosions)
🎵 New sounds and music — engine hum, booming explosions, a battle theme at red alert
🎓 Nova’s guided first flight, plus Easy, Normal and Hard
🧭 Get maths right to rise through the Navigator ranks — Master and Star Navigators get real perks!
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: Original / Retro / Modern styles (Modern uses a bundled 3D engine, loaded only when chosen, with automatic quality); new synthesised sound (engine, weapons and explosions placed left/right, hangar ambience, calm and battle music, docking clamps and landing gear) with Music and Engine & hangar switches; guided first flight; difficulty; floating rewards and kill flashes; cockpit glows red under attack; Navigator ranks for maths (Master: 10% less fuel per jump; Star: double Traders’ Guild bonuses).

kids: 🚀 Starlane Trader: a tidier pause menu with tabs — Game, Display, Sound & Voice, Controls, How to play
🧮 Starlane’s maths puzzles now practise your Focus topics
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: every screen checked automatically for overlaps and fixed (35 screens); pause menu split into five tabs; station tips shown across the top; in-game maths favours the Focus topics (and covers more of them) and every answer is logged in the Parent dashboard (Activity tab).

kids: 🏆 Starlane Trader: a Career Record — your fortune, fame, infamy, exploring, ship, maths and medals (press Z)
🤖 Nova now gives you a spoken welcome briefing before your first flight
items: 🚀 Starlane Trader: Career Record with fortune, fame and infamy (hero–villain balance), combat, explorer, ship, missions and maths statistics, titles, a Commander score and all medals; 4 new medals; Nova’s spoken intro (replay from the pause menu or Status).
